descriptionChirho: A container made from animal skin used for storing liquids such as wine or water. The multilingual glosses consistently use skin/leather container terms (mshk in Hindi, ziqq in Arabic, kiriba in Swahili, odre in Spanish).

An earthenware or clay container used for storage. The glosses point to ceramic vessels (jar, tinaja/vasija in Spanish, jarrah in Arabic, chungu/mtungi in Swahili), including a potter's vessel and generic vessels/jars.
